descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Manage Now is a leading managed service provider in Germany and offers its customers IT infrastructures, application management, hybrid cloud solutions and digital workplace solutions.
 At Manage Now, we’re embarking on an exciting journey to establish a cutting-edge Delivery Center in Romania . We are moving beyond traditional offshoring to create a dedicated center that promises flexibility, superior quality, and excellent growth potential.
 Your mission 
 As a Junior NetApp Storage Administrator, you will support the daily operation and maintenance of enterprise storage environments, working closely with experienced engineers and technical teams.
 Your responsibilities will include: 
Support the administration, monitoring, and maintenance of NetApp ONTAP storage systems.
Assist with storage provisioning, capacity monitoring, and basic performance checks.
Handle L1/L2 incidents, service requests, and routine troubleshooting activities.
Support SAN/NAS environments and related protocols such as NFS, CIFS/SMB, and iSCSI.
Assist with backup, snapshot, and replication operations, following established procedures.
Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers or vendor support.
Maintain technical documentation and contribute to operational knowledge sharing.
Participate in change management activities and continuous service improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with international teams to ensure reliable storage services.
 Your profile 
Around 1–2 years of experience in IT infrastructure, system administration, storage operations, or technical support.
Basic knowledge of storage concepts, including SAN/NAS technologies.
Initial hands-on experience with NetApp ONTAP or other enterprise storage solutions is an advantage.
Familiarity with Windows and/or Linux environments.
Basic understanding of networking concepts and storage protocols (NFS, SMB, iSCSI).
Interest in developing technical expertise in enterprise storage technologies.
Good troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn.
Good English communication skills and ability to work in an international team.
 Nice to Have 
Exposure to NetApp ONTAP administration, monitoring, or troubleshooting.
Knowledge of snapshots, replication, backup, or disaster recovery concepts.
Experience working with ITSM tools and ITIL-based processes.
NetApp certification (NCDA) or willingness to pursue certification with company support.
 Why us? 
Modern workplaces and equipment
Flexible working hours and extensive home office regulations
Dynamic company development
Comprehensive training and further education opportunities
Collaborative and supportive team culture with a strong focus on knowledge sharing and professional growth
Additional annual leave days beyond the statutory entitlement
